rows.definition: The deadlineadmit Estimator method that evaluates prompt tokens, caller-supplied cached tokens, output limit and remaining declared budget using measured rates and live concurrency. It returns a deadline admission verdict; callers are responsible for validating the supplied resident-prefix credit.
rows.distinction: This is a duration-budget decision using an already supplied cache count, rather than the promptcachekey identity used to distinguish cached prompts. It does not discover, allocate or prove KV residency.

rows.definition: The agent record of a llama-server slot task identifier, current processing state and prompt-token count obtained from the engine slots endpoint.
rows.distinction: The observation does not itself contain a slot ID, wire-prefix identity or local ownership. LlamaSoftSlotResidency adds the completed-call binding; llamaSoftSlotLease owns the local in-flight pin.

rows.definition: The agent request-local handle for a chosen soft slot, its conversation key and its existing release function. It can reserve the slot against other local picks while checking prepared-call residency, and releases the in-flight pin once. The slotLease local in prepareUpstreamContext holds this handle during preparation.
rows.distinction: This is active process-local routing ownership, not the engine observation in LlamaSlotTask or the completed wire-prefix evidence in LlamaSoftSlotResidency. Foreign upstream clients remain outside the local reservation.

rows.definition: The opaque agent record binding a completed measured request to its actual upstream base and dispatch endpoint, named soft slot, observed engine task and prompt count, serialized request envelope and message-prefix digest, and request credential digest.
rows.distinction: This records completed-call evidence for a later prepared-call comparison; it does not own the active local slot as llamaSoftSlotLease does. LlamaSlotTask alone lacks this slot and wire-prefix binding.

rows.definition: The agent helper that performs a bounded authenticated slots-endpoint read for one selected slot ID, rejects malformed or duplicate slot identities, and returns that slot task observation.
rows.distinction: This obtains one live LlamaSlotTask observation; it neither owns a local slot lease nor establishes completed-call residency by itself.

rows.definition: The per-upstreamCall binding held in its slotResidency field. It connects a request turn and optional local slot lease with the captured endpoint and credential digest, last eligible prepared proof, and one-shot completion channel/release.
rows.distinction: This is mutable state for one prepared upstream call. LlamaSoftSlotTurn carries the request across preparation, whereas LlamaSoftSlotResidency is the completed immutable evidence used by a later call.

rows.definition: The request-context carrier for an expected HTTP planner/base, optional previous soft-slot evidence, optional prepared-call deadline check, and the latest prepared-call observation channel.
rows.distinction: The turn spans upstream preparation and completion handoff. It is not the individual llamaPreparedSlot binding or the already completed LlamaSoftSlotResidency proof.

rows.definition: The HTTPPlanner method that checks soft-slot observation eligibility and returns a context carrying a new LlamaSoftSlotTurn together with that observer. Ineligible planners retain the original context and no observer.
rows.distinction: This constructs and attaches the request carrier; it does not select a slot, issue HTTP, or itself approve deadline credit as prepareDeadlineSoftSlot coordinates.

rows.definition: The HTTPPlanner request preparation method that retains the supplied request context while shaping and serializing the upstream call, selecting any local soft slot, resolving headers, and binding its soft-slot carrier.
rows.distinction: This prepares an upstream call without sending its POST. The prepared admission callback callContext is the actual execution context checked immediately before a later POST attempt.

rows.definition: The gateway helper that attaches eligible soft-slot observation and, only for a potentially creditable continuation, installs a deferred prepared-call deadline verdict and its cancellation/release ownership.
rows.distinction: This coordinates the gateway estimator and request lifetime. WithLlamaSoftSlotResidency only attaches the agent carrier; AdmitCached evaluates the supplied token and time budget without establishing slot evidence.

rows.definition: The context argument received by the deferred soft-slot admission callback immediately before an upstream POST attempt. Its cancellation and deadline reflect the actual call, including any shorter child watchdog.
rows.distinction: This is an execution-time context value rather than the prepareUpstreamContext method. It can carry a shorter deadline than the ingress client-budget context, which the callback respects when pricing admission.
